feed.checkpoint: Contiguous immutable global sequence; high_watermark and checked_at are obtained from the same producer snapshot.
feed.postings: Exactly two equal opposite integer minor-unit entries per fact. No private evidence or customer names.

privacy: Current actor, organization, record permission and source revision are checked for every read, export and operation lookup. Seller totals filter before aggregation. Only a current financial_reports.operator permission permits platform reconciliation. No public cache, logs or previews.
authority: Read-only projection. Never authorizes collection, receipt, approval, refund or release. No Pricing input.
recovery: Retry the same operation_id and exact request. Conflicting bindings deny. Revision changes return stale without rows or totals. Missing, delayed, unbalanced or conflicting feed returns pending or drift without financial totals.
